requirements.requirement: JOIN BUTTON MUST PHYSICALLY LEAVE WITH THE PAGE
requirements.implementation: Captured committed button remains on its own supported mesh until the 8.25-second release; real interaction is inert.

requirements.requirement: UNIFY THE PAGE TITLE WITH THE CINEMATIC FOCUS TITLE
requirements.implementation: One captured original heading arcs into the focus surface; capitalization resolves during its edge-on turn.

requirements.requirement: ORIGINAL PAGE FAILURE — SUPPORT-PLANE PHYSICS
requirements.implementation: Subdivided surfaces retain central support while free edges peel; differentiated corner anchors fail in sequence.

requirements.requirement: COMPONENTS MUST TUMBLE / CURL / REORIENT AFTER RELEASE
requirements.implementation: Released surfaces carry material-dependent angular momentum, curl and yaw/pitch/roll; heavier panels resist rotation.

requirements.requirement: SPATIALLY COHERENT WIND
requirements.implementation: Two world-position vortex tubes and a shared rear-origin velocity field drive neighboring materials coherently.

requirements.requirement: DO NOT FADE OBJECTS WHILE THEY ARE STILL NEARBY
requirements.implementation: Opaque physical pieces leave through perspective/frustum or atmospheric depth; no per-lifetime near-object fade.

requirements.requirement: INCREASE PARCHMENT / SMALL PHYSICAL MATERIAL DENSITY
requirements.implementation: 118 varied small paper/material actors supplement the authored heroes and begin behind the eye.

requirements.requirement: CONTINUE MATERIAL THROUGH STAGE B
requirements.implementation: Integrated trajectories continue through landscape reveal; no Stage B position, velocity or angular reset.

requirements.requirement: REMOVE THE CURRENT ROPE PROP
requirements.implementation: The isolated P5 rope prop and its scheduled event are omitted; source and provenance remain preserved.

requirements.requirement: MORE REALISTIC MIST — DO NOT USE VISIBLE ART AS THE EFFECT
requirements.implementation: Advected multiscale world-space density, gaps, vortex distortion and near/far integration replace literal mist artwork.

requirements.requirement: MUCH MORE REALISTIC WATER SPRAY
requirements.implementation: 2100 seeded instanced spray droplets use velocity stretch, clustered breakup, distance, focus and blur.

requirements.requirement: WATER MAY ACTUALLY HIT THE VIRTUAL LENS
requirements.implementation: Twelve sparse drops across three impact events refract the rendered scene, adhere, elongate, merge and drain before 19.3 seconds.

requirements.requirement: MAP HERO PASS — SMALLER AND SLOWER
requirements.implementation: The writing/map hero has a smaller physical size and longer near-camera passage with flexible deformation.

requirements.requirement: STAGE B MUST BECOME A REAL CINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT
requirements.implementation: Four original-pixel island/shore mattes occupy separate perspective planes over reconstructed sky/water; camera explores forward and laterally.

requirements.requirement: DELAY THE STAGE B → FINAL EXTERIOR TRANSITION
requirements.implementation: 16–22 seconds belong to landscape exploration and calming weather before fog transport begins.

requirements.requirement: GIVE THE STAGE B MOON REAL LIGHTING PRESENCE
requirements.implementation: World-space moon anchors material lighting, restrained scattering and existing water-reflection modulation.

requirements.requirement: NEW STAGE B → FINAL EXTERIOR FOG TRANSITION
requirements.implementation: 22–27 seconds use continuously advected patchy fog with gradual density buildup/clearance and density-gradient illumination.

requirements.requirement: MOON CONTINUITY THROUGH THE FOG
requirements.implementation: A single celestial body reconciles between registered positions behind dense fog; duplicate painted discs are removed from support backings.

requirements.requirement: FINAL EXTERIOR MOON / WATER RESPONSE
requirements.implementation: Existing silver/warm reflections deform with masked water and sparse irregular glints; camera stays fixed after arrival.

requirements.requirement: STAGE B / FINAL EXTERIOR TRANSITION MUST NOT HAVE A DISCERNIBLE SWAP FRAME
requirements.implementation: Final moving review at 1×, 0.5× and 0.25× found the landscape reconciliation concealed by continuous fog; perceptual owner acceptance remains pending.

requirements.requirement: FINAL EXTERIOR → MUSTER ENTRY: MORE TRAVEL, LESS WARPING
requirements.implementation: 27–31-second backward camera translation uses deeper fixed architecture, physical aperture, expanded room/exterior backing and a fixed near lantern.

requirements.requirement: MOVING FINAL ENVIRONMENT ELEMENTS MUST BE TRUE SEPARATE LAYERS
requirements.implementation: Original-pixel lantern/attachment and flame RGBA layers sit over filled static backing; wick and suspension pivots avoid moving neighboring wood/sky.

requirements.requirement: LANTERN / CANDLE AMBIENCE REMAINS LIVING
requirements.implementation: Continuous phase and residual damping preserve restrained ambient character; camera, sign and cushion remain fixed.

requirements.requirement: INCOMING MUSTER UI — DO NOT ARRIVE ALL AT ONCE
requirements.implementation: Independent measured targets have staggered 30.9–34.35-second flight/catch/settle intervals, including Invite Crew where canonical authority allows it.

requirements.requirement: INCOMING MUSTER UI MUST TRAVEL THROUGH REAL SPACE
requirements.implementation: Actual mounted DOM elements begin behind the perspective eye, cross into the near field and travel to their measured layout locations without proxy swaps.

requirements.requirement: ANCHOR-CATCH EVENTS MUST BE READABLE
requirements.implementation: Support-point rotation, catch impulse, asymmetric membrane tension and material-dependent damping make arrival visibly catch before relaxing.

requirements.requirement: PRESERVE PHYSICAL SYMMETRY
requirements.implementation: Outgoing support/failure and incoming free-flight/catch share material pressure and the coherent wind envelope.

requirements.requirement: VELOCITY CONTINUITY ACROSS ENVIRONMENT BOUNDARIES
requirements.implementation: One seekable integrated trajectory cache and continuously advected field span all environment beats.

requirements.requirement: ATMOSPHERIC / OBJECT DENSITY SHOULD FOLLOW NARRATIVE ENERGY
requirements.implementation: Storm crest at 12.15 precedes Stage B; water and hard clutter decline into wonder, fog is low-clutter, cinematic material clears before stillness.

requirements.requirement: NO EFFECT SHOULD LOOK LIKE AN ASSET
requirements.implementation: Effects are procedural or isolated material derivatives; no full P10/P11/P13/P14/P15 source sheet is a runtime scene layer.

requirements.requirement: SELF-REVIEW / OWNER IS NOT FIRST QA
requirements.implementation: Full-film 1×/0.5×/0.25× playback, exact-time scrubber, final targeted fog/threshold replays and desktop/tablet/phone inspection completed; defects corrected before owner screening.

requirements.requirement: STOP POINT
requirements.implementation: Owned preview remains running at port 3138; report supplied; no merge, OWNER_ACCEPTED or adjacent Refit work.
